keyEvents.text: Goal! Inter Club D'Escaldes 1, FC Copenhagen 0. David López (Inter Club D'Escaldes) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner following a set piece situation.
First Half ends, Inter Club D'Escaldes 1, FC Copenhagen 0.
Substitution, FC Copenhagen. Geovanni Vianney Ndjee replaces Viktor Dadason.
Substitution, FC Copenhagen. Robert Silva replaces Hunor Németh.
Substitution, FC Copenhagen. Thapelo Maseko replaces Maher Carrizo.
Second Half begins Inter Club D'Escaldes 1, FC Copenhagen 0.
Thomas Delaney (FC Copenhagen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Thomas Delaney (FC Copenhagen) for a bad foul.
Ákos Markgráf (FC Copenhagen) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Goal! Inter Club D'Escaldes 2, FC Copenhagen 0. Faysal Chouaib (Inter Club D'Escaldes) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, FC Copenhagen. Felix Beijmo replaces Mohamed Elyounoussi.
Substitution, FC Copenhagen. Birger Meling replaces Alex Král.
Substitution, Inter Club D'Escaldes. Borja Arellano replaces Souleymane Sidibé.
